scope: Home H225 published discovery pool versus Customs-400 proposed EN/FR reader copy
policy: A rewritten translation or broader paraphrase of an already published custom does not create a new discovery. Keep all originals for provenance; exclude overlaps from release rather than deleting historical source records.

overlap_dispositions.basis: Same original source plus comparison of reader-facing claims finds the same customary practice; no source-distinct new discovery demonstrated.
overlap_dispositions.public_en: A 1956 Catholic blessing book directs the priest to hold two blessed candles in the form of a cross under a person's chin for Saint Blaise's throat blessing.
overlap_dispositions.candidate_en: On 3 February, the feast of Saint Blaise, a traditional blessing invokes the saint's intercession against illnesses of the throat. In the older Roman Ritual, a priest uses two crossed blessed candles during the prayer.
